name: sitecore-migration-workbench
description: Sitecore XP to SitecoreAI Migration Workbench

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 file:dist/electron/main.js && cross-env NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 node scripts/start-electron.cjs"
scripts.build: vite build && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
